source.title: National Environmental Agency 2025 annual report
source.locator: Water resources monitoring: groundwater pp. 10–12; surface waters p. 13 (page locations from report contents)

surface_water.matrix_separation_note: Surface-water counts are kept separate from groundwater monitoring and must not be pooled into drinking-water compliance or groundwater trends.

limitations: These are source-reported annual aggregate counts, not sample-level analytical results or unique sample identifiers.
The report lists 74 laboratory-sampling points and separately lists parameter coverage at 73 groundwater points; their relationship is not explained and must not be inferred.
The 681 laboratory sample counts by analysis group are not a compliance numerator or denominator and may not represent unique physical samples.
No station/sample dictionary, coordinates, sample dates, analyte values, units, LOD/LOQ, standard versions, lab QA/QC or reuse terms are supplied in this aggregate snapshot.
The 2025 annual report is distinct from the 2021–2025 groundwater RAR announced on 2026-11-26; the RAR archive was not retrieved.
